cohort: The study included women admitted to the maternity ward of Nigde Omer Halisdemir University Hospital between 2021 and 2023, comprising 50 patients who developed post-cesarean infections (cases) and 50 control patients without infections.
finding: Postoperative monocyte-to-lymphocyte ratio (MLR) and neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) were significantly elevated in patients with post-cesarean section infections, suggesting their utility as effective biomarkers for early detection.
